csv_project_name: Consultant for New Unified Development Code
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Omaha ("City") is seeking Statements of Qualifications from multidisciplinary consulting teams to prepare a new Unified Development Code (UDC). The UDC will consolidate and modernize the City's zoning, subdivision, and related land development regulations into a single, coordinated regulatory document that is clear, predictable, legally defensible, and readily administered. The City expects the selected consultant to provide all professional services necessary to prepare and support adoption of a Unified Development Code.
